alerts.reason: VIAVI’s March-quarter net revenue fell 0.7% year over year (A). Stronger OSP demand partly offset weakness among service-provider and enterprise customers (B), supporting a forecast that the June-quarter change stays above -5%. With end-market demand still volatile (C), I forecast that persistent customer weakness outweighs that offset in the quarter beginning June 30, taking reported revenue to a year-over-year decline of at least 5%.
